name: source_subcostal_sweep
status: frozen 2026-10-23 (generator QC on 24 train/val patients; censoring rule chosen on train/val)
description: GB-blind subcostal liver sweep: start high epigastric / right subcostal under the costal margin, move laterally along the right costal margin keeping a useful liver window. Uses only skin, bone/air blockers, costal margin and liver.

posthoc.censoring_rule: t_GB = first pose t (0-based) where the frozen target visibility criterion V of configs/target_la.json holds: geometric GB area in the fan >= max(0.5 * A_max, 100 mm^2) and GB centroid depth 30-150 mm. Source observations = O_1:t_GB (poses 0..t_GB-1), the pre-target-acquisition observations. A sub-threshold GB sliver may already be in those frames. If V never holds, the whole trajectory is pre-acquisition.

notes: contact_depth_mm 20: the probe face is pressed into the skin (soft-tissue compression 1-2 cm), a 12 mm allowance rejected most epigastric starts; progress_min_mm +1: a sweep is monotone laterally (with -1 the search stalled)

observation.notes: train/fan_geometry pixel grid (128x128, 1.85 mm); liver channel cleaned with train/observation.clean_observation (components < 1 cm^2 removed), geometric (shadow not applied); shadow = behind the first bone/air blocker (gb_target.Patient.shadow); bit-packed along the last axis. Rendered from the GB-blind patient (labels body/liver only, as data/planes).
